description.raw:
'''Active:''' '''Jax''' enters ''Evasion'' for 2 seconds: a defensive stance that causes him to [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodge]] all incoming non-[[File:Turret icon.png|20px|link=Turret|An icon representing the keyword Turret]] [[:Turret|turret]] basic attacks and take 25% reduced damage from all [[File:Mega Inferno Bomb.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Area damage]] [[:Damage|area of effect]] [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|abilities]] sourced from [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]].

''Counter Strike'' can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after the duration.
description.text:
Active: Jax enters Evasion for 2 seconds: a defensive stance that causes him to dodge all incoming non- turret basic attacks and take 25% reduced damage from all area of effect abilities sourced from champions.
Counter Strike can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after the duration.

description2.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Jax''' deals magic damage to nearby enemies, with the '''total''' damage increased by 20% for each attack dodged, up to a 100% increase, and [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stuns]] them for 1 second.
description2.text: Recast: Jax deals magic damage to nearby enemies, with the total damage increased by 20% for each attack dodged, up to a 100% increase, and stuns them for 1 second.

notes.raw: * The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. * ''Counter Strike'' will also dodge abilities that can trigger [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effects ([[File:Gangplank Parrrley.png|20xpx|border|link=Gangplank#Parrrley|An icon for Gangplank's ability Parrrley]] [[Gangplank#Parrrley|Parrrley]], [[File:Ezreal Mystic Shot.png|20xpx|border|link=Ezreal#Mystic Shot|An icon for Ezreal's ability Mystic Shot]] [[Ezreal#Mystic Shot|Mystic Shot]]) which will count towards ''Counter Strike's'' increased damage. There are exceptions of abilities that ''Counter Strike'' will not dodge but will dodge the damage from [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effects that they trigger ([[File:Master Yi Alpha Strike.png|20xpx|border|link=Master Yi#Alpha Strike|An icon for Master Yi's ability Alpha Strike]] [[Master Yi#Alpha Strike|Alpha Strike]], [[File:Senna Piercing Darkness.png|20xpx|border|link=Senna#Piercing Darkness|An icon for Senna's ability Piercing Darkness]] [[Senna#Piercing Darkness|Piercing Darkness]]). * The damage based on the target's maximum health is capped at 9000 against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]]. This is a placeholder value and impossible to reach because it requires a monster to have over 128571 health.
notes.text:
The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
Counter Strike will also dodge abilities that can trigger on-hit effects ( Parrrley, Mystic Shot) which will count towards Counter Strike's increased damage. There are exceptions of abilities that Counter Strike will not dodge but will dodge the damage from on-hit effects that they trigger ( Alpha Strike, Piercing Darkness).
The damage based on the target's maximum health is capped at 9000 against monsters. This is a placeholder value and impossible to reach because it requires a monster to have over 128571 health.
